claim: Planet R rotates once on its axis in 1 Earth day.
evidence: Planet R has a solar-day cycle of 3 Earth days. Its axial rotation period is 7 Earth days.
required_quote: Its axial rotation period is 7 Earth days.
excluded_quotes: Planet R has a solar-day cycle of 3 Earth days.
gold_rationale: Both different period values differ from1day; only axial rotation can contradict the asserted measurement basis. Extra solar-day proof remains irrelevant.

claim: Device R has a battery runtime of 2 hours.
evidence: Device R has an expected useful lifetime of 9 years. Its measured battery runtime is 6 hours.
required_quote: Its measured battery runtime is 6 hours.
excluded_quotes: Device R has an expected useful lifetime of 9 years.
gold_rationale: Lifetime and runtime both differ numerically from2, but only runtime evidence grounds the claim; shared numerical incompatibility cannot justify wrong-metric proof.
